metadata.task_goal: Establish a documented handoff for a preliminary newborn-screen result using the nursery record, specimen material, and screening evidence.

files./workspace/newborn/request.txt:
TRANSFER REQUEST
Patient ID: PAT-V3-2901
A newborn is scheduled for transfer from the birth hospital to a step-down nursery. The transfer reference is NB-V3-2901.
files./workspace/newborn/current.txt:
CURRENT NURSERY RECORD
Patient ID: PAT-V3-2901
The infant is feeding with support and has stable routine observations. The transfer note is drafted but unsigned. No specialist assessment is documented in the current encounter.
files./workspace/newborn/specimen.txt:
SPECIMEN MATERIAL
The newborn screening card was collected at 19 hours of life. The card record notes an incomplete heel-warming field. A second-card collection order appears in the queue without a collection time.
files./workspace/newborn/evidence.txt:
SCREENING EVIDENCE
The state screening interface flags an elevated marker associated with a metabolic screening panel. The interface labels the finding preliminary. No confirmatory assay result is present.
files./workspace/newborn/procedure.md:
WORKSPACE NOTE
The workspace includes a transfer request, nursery record, specimen material, and screening evidence. Source timing, authorship, and scope may differ.
